mo_ta_cong_viec:
The major role & responsibilities includes: 
Collect and analyze the requirements for product and solution from internal/external customer through research, interviews, and regular feedbacks 
Contribute to requirement gathering, user clarifications, IT walkthrough and ensure quality delivery
Monitor the progress of project development and assist Delivery Manager in task planning and scope/CR management 
Provide professional documentation for product and solution such as BRD, Business workflow/data flow, etc 
Produce detailed product and functional requirements that will drive product development, testing and deployment 
Work with development teams to align on project schedules, manages feature delivery, and ensure implementing effective and efficient business solutions 
Have the ability to research new technologies and technical difficulties 
Establish and maintain professional and consultative relationships with internal/external clients, communicate with business stakeholders throughout project lifecycle 
Maintain expertise and knowledge of business domain, technologies, and solutions 
Perform risk management to minimize the project risks 
Support to evaluate the outcomes/deliverables of project as established during the planning phase 
Write testing scenarios for UAT, support UAT and verifying bugs/issues
Perform related work as assigned by direct line manager
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s degree preferably in Computer Science or Business Information System or Business Administration 
Obtaining IT knowledge-base, basic knowledge of database such as database schema and simple SQL query 
At least 1-3 years of working experience with 1 years in analyzing requirements or product development as Business Analyst position 
Knowledge of testing approaches and techniques 
General understanding and experience of business processes as well as interest in understanding a broad range of CPG business models
 Proficiency in BA techniques, tools and business areas 
Good interpersonal and strong English communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and team members
